title: Padua International Excellence Scholarship
amount: €8,000 gross per year + full fee exemption
eligible: Open to international (non-Italian) students applying to an English-taught degree programme at the University of Padua. Applicants must not hold Italian citizenship (unless dual), must not be resident in Italy, and must hold a foreign secondary school diploma (Bachelor's) or foreign degree (Master's).
desc: The University of Padua offers up to 68 scholarships to brilliant international students attending an English-taught Bachelor's or Master's degree. The scholarship is €8,000 gross per year plus full exemption from student fees (beneficiaries pay only the regional fee and revenue stamp). Awarded on academic merit; applying to the degree programme automatically enters you into the selection. The scholarship is paid in two instalments of €4,000 gross per academic year.

title: Padua Full Fee Waivers for International Students
duration: 1 academic year, renewable up to 3 years
eligible: International (non-Italian) students enrolling in an English-taught degree programme at the University of Padua. Must not hold Italian citizenship (unless dual), must not already be resident in Italy, and must hold a foreign diploma.
desc: The University of Padua offers 100 full tuition fee waivers to outstanding international students enrolling in an English-taught degree programme. Beneficiaries pay only the regional tax and stamp duty and are exempt from the second and third instalments of tuition fees. The waiver is offered for one academic year and may be renewed (2nd year requires at least 25 credits by 10 August; 3rd year for Bachelor's requires 80 credits by 10 August of the second year). Selection is based on the previous academic record.

title: Padua Departmental Scholarships for International Students
eligible: International students admitted to the listed English-taught degree programmes at participating Padua departments (FISPPA, ICEA, DII, DM, DIMED, DPSS, SPGI, DISLL, TeSAF).
desc: Several departments of the University of Padua offer scholarships for international students in their English-taught degree programmes, including Psychology, Social Sciences and Digital Data, Environmental/Water and Geological Risk/Energy/Materials/Electrical/Aerospace Engineering, Computational Finance, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Mathematics, Medicine and Surgery, Applied Child and Adolescent Psychology, Human Rights and Multi-level Governance, European and Global Studies, Communication Strategies, and Forest Sciences. Each scholarship is €8,000 pre-tax per year plus exemption from student fees.

title: MAECI Scholarships at the University of Padua
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
eligible: International students and Italian students residing permanently abroad (IRE), from the MAECI beneficiary-country list, applying to a Master's, PhD or research project at the University of Padua. Age limit: 28 (Master's), 30 (PhD), 40 (research).
lang: B2 CEFR in Italian (Italian-taught courses) or English (English-taught courses)
desc: The Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI) provides scholarships for international students and Italian students residing permanently abroad to carry out study, training and/or research programmes at Italian institutions. At the University of Padua this covers Master's degrees, PhD courses and research projects. The scholarship consists of €900 per month for 6 to 9 months. Application is made online through the Ministry's website (studyinitaly.esteri.it), and you must also enrol in the chosen degree programme at the University of Padua.

title: Invest Your Talent in Italy — University of Padua
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
eligible: Citizens of Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ethiopia, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Iran, Kazakhstan, Mexico, People's Republic of China, Republic of Korea, Tunisia, Turkey and Vietnam, holding a Bachelor's degree and applying to an eligible English-taught Master's at the University of Padua.
desc: Invest Your Talent in Italy supports international students enrolling in an English-taught Master's degree in Engineering/High Technologies, Design/Architecture or Economics/Management at the University of Padua. The scholarship includes €1,000 net per month for 9 months (renewable for the second year subject to achieving at least 30 ECTS by 20 July), tuition fee waivers, living expenses and support services, plus a mandatory 3-month traineeship at a major Italian company.

title: Galilean School of Higher Studies Scholarships for International Students
amount: €2,500 scholarship + free room and board + flight reimbursement up to €1,500
eligible: International students holding (or planning to obtain) a Bachelor's degree, admitted or eligible for a Master's degree programme at the University of Padua, and not yet 25 years old at the time of application.
desc: The Galilean School of Higher Education (Scuola Galileiana di Studi Superiori) is the University of Padua's school of excellence. International students admitted to the school receive free room and board at university residences and canteens, a scholarship of €2,500, a return flight ticket to/from their country of origin (up to €1,500) per academic year, reimbursement of documented expenses, language courses and personalised tutoring. Application window is typically 25 March to 31 May.

title: Sapienza International Post-degree Scholarship
eligible: Sapienza Master's degree (or single-cycle) graduates, 28 years old or younger at the announcement of the call, applying to pursue third-cycle study or postgraduate training at an international university institution outside Italy. For non-Italian citizens the host institution must be in a country other than their country of origin.
desc: The International Post-degree Scholarship supports participation in third-cycle study programmes or postgraduate advanced training activities at international university-level institutions outside Italy. Call 2026 awards 400 months of scholarships at €1,290 per month, with duration of 6 to 12 months. Applications must be submitted by 16 September 2026. The call is published every year in April/May on the Amministrazione trasparente portal.

title: Sapienza International Thesis Scholarship
eligible: Sapienza students enrolled at least in the first year of a two-year Master's degree, or in the last/second-to-last year of a single-cycle degree, who want to conduct part of their thesis research abroad.
desc: The International Thesis Scholarship supports Sapienza students who want to conduct part of their thesis research abroad at institutions, companies or international organisations of higher scientific and cultural level. The research must last at least two consecutive months and the amount for the whole internship is €2,821 gross. Each faculty issues its own call; applications are submitted at the faculty presidencies.

title: Sapienza IUPALS Scholarship for Palestinian Students
amount: Fee exemption + accommodation, meals and health insurance
eligible: Students residing in the Palestinian Territories applying to an English-taught Bachelor's degree at Sapienza (Classics, Global Humanities, Business Sciences, Economics and Finance).
desc: IUPALS (Italian Universities for Palestinian Students) provides scholarships allowing students residing in the Palestinian Territories to pursue their studies in Italy. Sapienza awards 2 scholarships including exemption from university fees, accommodation, meals and health insurance costs. Eligible English-taught Bachelor's degrees: Classics, Global Humanities, Business Sciences, Economics and Finance. Application via the Universitaly portal, Infostud registration, then emailing documents to dirittoallostudio@uniroma1.it (passport, secondary school diploma, transcripts, English B2 certification).

title: Sapienza Scholarships for Meritorious Students from Italian and International Universities
amount: €4,300 per year (11 scholarships) or €3,000 per year (85 scholarships)
eligible: EU and non-EU graduates (excluding Italian citizens) for the 'Don't Miss Your Chance' call (requires SAT certificate); graduates of other Italian universities with a grade between 105/110 and 110/110 cum laude enrolling in a Master's at Sapienza for the 'Wanted the Best' call.
desc: Sapienza awards two-year scholarships to meritorious students: 'Don't Miss Your Chance' awards 11 scholarships of €4,300 per year to EU and non-EU graduates (excluding Italian citizens) who hold a SAT certificate, with exemption from tuition fees; 'Wanted the Best' awards 85 scholarships of €3,000 per year to students who obtained a first degree at other Italian universities with a grade of 105/110 to 110/110 cum laude and enrol in a Master's degree at Sapienza.

title: Unibo Action 1 & 2 Scholarships for International Students
amount: €11,000 gross study grant (Action 2) or full tuition fee waiver (Action 1)
eligible: International students enrolling in a first-cycle (Bachelor's) or second-cycle (Master's) degree programme at the University of Bologna. Unibo Action 2 study grants are assigned on the basis of SAT and GRE tests.
desc: The University of Bologna offers international students two merit-based opportunities: Unibo Action 2 study grants of €11,000 gross per academic year and Unibo Action 1 tuition fee waivers. Both are assigned on the basis of SAT and GRE test scores. The call for applications is published annually; application for the scholarship and admission to the degree programme are separate procedures, and grants are generally not cumulative.

title: University of Tokyo Fellowship for International Students
duration: standard period of study of the graduate programme
eligible: Outstanding self-funded international students pursuing degree programmes (Master's, PhD, professional degrees) at the University of Tokyo, or research students (up to one year).
desc: The University of Tokyo Fellowship is a research grant-in-aid established in 2004 to support outstanding, self-funded international students pursuing degrees at the University and to promote the enrolment of exceptional international students. Recipients are awarded ¥200,000 per month for the standard period of study of their graduate programme (up to one year for research students). In AY 2025, 44 new recipients were selected (110 graduate students total). Applications are submitted through the applicant's affiliated or prospective Graduate School.

title: University of Tokyo Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
eligible: International students applying through the Japanese embassy/consulate (embassy recommendation) or the university (university recommendation). At UTokyo, categories are Research students (Master's, Doctorate, Professional Degree) and Undergraduate students.
desc: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship allows students to study at the University of Tokyo with a scholarship from the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology. UTokyo accepts students as Research students (Master's, Doctorate, Professional Degree programmes) and Undergraduate students. Applications are made through Japanese embassies (embassy recommendation) or the university (university recommendation) before matriculation. Refer to the Application Guideline for the year you are applying to.

title: Kyoto iUP Scholarship (International Undergraduate Program)
amount: Full admission and tuition fee waivers + monthly allowance up to ¥120,000 during preparatory course
eligible: International students admitted to the Kyoto iUP (International Undergraduate Program), a 4.5-year English-based program taught in Japanese at Kyoto University.
desc: The Kyoto iUP is Kyoto University's International Undergraduate Program combining a six-month preparatory course with a four-year undergraduate degree taught in Japanese. Scholarships include full admission fee waivers and full or partial tuition fee waivers for four-and-a-half years, plus a monthly allowance of up to ¥120,000 for all students during the six-month preparatory course. After enrolment, merit-based monthly allowances from supporting companies and organizations are available to eligible students.

title: Kyoto University Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
eligible: International students in the seven MEXT categories, selected overseas via embassy recommendation or at Kyoto University via university recommendation.
desc: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship, funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, is available to seven categories of students at Kyoto University. Most MEXT scholarship students at Kyoto University earned their scholarship through embassy recommendation. Applications should be made before matriculation, either through a Japanese embassy or consulate (embassy recommendations) or through the host university in Japan (university recommendations).

title: Nagoya University Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
eligible: International students at Nagoya University in the MEXT categories: undergraduate, research students, non-degree students, Master's course, Doctoral course, Young Leaders' Program.
desc: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship at Nagoya University provides monthly stipends (2019 schedule): ¥117,000 for undergraduate students, ¥143,000 for research students, ¥144,000 for Master's course, ¥145,000 for Doctoral course, and ¥242,000 for Young Leaders' Program students, with an additional ¥2,000–3,000 for designated regions (¥3,000 in Nagoya city). Stipends are deposited by JASSO into students' postal savings accounts. Extension of tenure is possible for those proceeding to a higher degree, subject to MEXT GPA requirements.

title: SNU Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) for Undergraduate Students
amount: Full tuition (8 semesters) + ₩1,200,000/month + airfare + Korean language training
duration: up to 8 semesters + 1 year Korean training
eligible: International applicants who wish to apply for undergraduate programmes at Seoul National University. Applications are submitted to Korean embassies in applicants' countries, which make the first selection; NIIED makes the final selection.
desc: The Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) at Seoul National University covers full tuition for 8 semesters, a monthly allowance of ₩1,200,000 (including living expenses, textbooks, insurance premiums and TOPIK scholarships), one economy round-trip airfare, and one year of Korean language training (mandatory — students must achieve TOPIK grade 3 within a year to enter the degree programme). Application period is September; selection is made through Korean embassies and NIIED.

title: SNU President Fellowship Program (SPF)
eligible: Faculty members of a major university in a developing country WITHOUT a Ph.D. degree, newly admitted to SNU as Ph.D. students (priority to faculty from major universities in developing countries in Asia, Africa, South America). Approximately 8 recipients per semester.
desc: The SNU President Fellowship Program (SPF) supports faculty members of major universities in developing countries who are newly admitted as Ph.D. students at Seoul National University. Benefits include full tuition exemption for up to 6 semesters, living expenses of ₩1,500,000–2,000,000 per month for 3-4 years, round-trip economy airfare, Korean language training, and National Health Insurance fee reimbursement. Apply for the scholarship together with the online admission application.

title: SNU Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)
eligible: Non-Korean applicants from eligible countries, enrolled or graduated, who are accepted into SNU and applied to a designated college/school participating in the GSFS Program. Approximately 20 recipients per semester.
desc: The Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS) at Seoul National University provides full tuition exemption for up to 4 semesters and a living expense allowance of at least ₩500,000 per month (varying by major) to approximately 20 non-Korean graduate students per semester. Applicants must apply for the scholarship at the same time as the online admission application. The list of eligible countries and participating colleges differs every semester.

title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
amount: Full study and living costs during the Master's degree
eligible: Excellent Master's students (no MAS) at ETH Zurich. The next application window is open 1-30 November 2026 (11:59 MEZ) for a start in the Master programme in HS27.
desc: The Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) at ETH Zurich supports excellent Master's students with a scholarship, mentorship and a network of the ETH Foundation. The scholarship covers the full study and living costs during the Master's degree course. The next application window is open 1-30 November 2026 (11:59 MEZ) for a start in the Master programme in HS27.

title: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships
eligible: Outstanding students beginning their Master's studies at EPFL, whether they obtained their Bachelor's degree at EPFL or at another institution, with remarkable academic results and distinguished extracurricular achievements (sporting, artistic, civic or entrepreneurial).
desc: EPFL offers a limited number of Master excellence fellowships, along with guaranteed housing, to the most outstanding students beginning their Master's studies. The fellowships are worth CHF 10,000 per semester and are available to students who obtained their Bachelor's degree at EPFL or at another institution. Candidates check the corresponding box on their Master's application form and provide the requested application file. Renewal for the second year requires at least 50 ECTS credits and an overall average of 5.0/6.

title: UPF-BSM Merit Based Scholarship
provider: UPF Barcelona School of Management (Universitat Pompeu Fabra)
amount: 25% of total tuition (up to +25% more in difficult economic situations)
eligible: Students applying to a master's programme at UPF Barcelona School of Management who can demonstrate talent, motivation and a university qualification. The percentage can be enlarged by up to an additional 25% if the candidate can prove a difficult economic situation. A minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 applies. Award is conditional on obtaining the degree by the start of the programme.
desc: The UPF Barcelona School of Management, through UPF's Institute of Continuing Education Foundation, annually awards the Merit Based Scholarship to finance master's studies of students who can demonstrate talent and motivation. The scholarship covers 25% of the total tuition fee, and the percentage may be enlarged by up to an additional 25% if candidates can prove a difficult economic situation. Requirements include a completed university qualification and, for those still pursuing a degree, maintaining the required grade point average (minimum 3.0/4.0).

title: UC3M Scholarships for University Master's Degrees
eligible: Students admitted to a university master's degree programme at Charles III University of Madrid (UC3M). Includes the School of Graduate Studies scholarship programme covering a fixed amount of tuition fees, the aid programme for research-oriented master's degrees (AEM_UC3M), and Santander-UC3M collaboration grants.
desc: Charles III University of Madrid (UC3M) offers several scholarship programmes to study a university master's degree, organised by the School of Graduate Studies: a scholarship programme covering a fixed amount of master's tuition fees, an aid programme for research-oriented master's degree programmes subject to specific objectives (call AEM_UC3M), and scholarship and study-grant programmes under the Santander-UC3M collaboration agreement. Calls for the 2026/27 academic year are published on the official page.

title: Waseda University Partial Tuition-Waiver Scholarship for Privately Financed International Students
eligible: Privately financed international students with 'Student' visa status enrolled in a regular degree-seeking course at Waseda University. Government-sponsored students, exchange students and non-degree students are not eligible.
desc: Waseda University offers the Partial Tuition-Waiver Scholarship for Privately Financed International Students, covering 50% of annual tuition. It is available to privately financed international students with 'Student' visa status enrolled in a regular degree-seeking course. Waseda provides around 250 different scholarships in total, including about 150 for international students, across internal scholarships, external scholarships via university recommendation, and external open-recruitment scholarships.
